diagnostic_profiles.interpretation: Diagnostic cProfile data only; collection sums eight worker profiles. Cumulative times overlap. Excluded from throughput medians.
diagnostic_profiles.remaining_bottleneck: Collection remains about two-thirds of process time. Public-state conversion/validation and protected engine snapshot work dominate worker profiles; tensor math dominates PPO updates.

implementation_choices: Bounded cached readers retain only schema metadata; all input and semantic validation still runs.
Annotation identity preserves order-sensitive union parsing; recursive field readers resolve lazily.
Generic substitutions remain per parse, and serialization field-name lists are cached separately.
Frozen vocabulary identity is calculated once at construction with identical canonical wire/hash.
No architecture, masks, seeds, reward, GAE, optimizer, recording, checkpoint or worker-scheduling changes.

phase_timings.note: Implementation elapsed was not separately measured. Validation, review and artifact-check timings can overlap; do not sum them as task wall time.

limitations: One machine and seed schedule, three repetitions per version.
OS caches and background load uncontrolled.
Profile wall times include instrumentation and are excluded from throughput medians.
50k estimate is linear extrapolation; later model behavior and game lengths can change throughput.
Parent peak RSS excludes worker processes.
protocol.schedule: Three baseline invocations, separate diagnostic profile, implementation/checks, three optimized invocations, separate diagnostic profile; fresh parent per invocation and workers retained within it.

scope: Headless CPU throughput only; one learner repeated on identical workload; no strength evaluation or checkpoint promotion.
